name: Data centre busway (overhead busbar power distribution)
description: Overhead extruded-aluminium busbar runs that carry power across a data hall and let plug-in tap-off units be added or moved at any point without shutting the run down — the reason busway has displaced cable trays for in-hall distribution. Starline's ranges illustrate the class: Track Busway 40-1250 A, Series-S 100-1200 A (IP54) and high-power enclosed busway 630-6000 A (to IP65), with plug-in units carrying integrated circuit protection and a metering family for branch-level monitoring.

subtypes.name: Track busway (continuous access)
subtypes.description: Open-channel run with plug-in units insertable at any location at any time.

subtypes.name: High-power enclosed busway
subtypes.description: Higher-amperage enclosed runs feeding rows or halls; IP54 to IP65 ingress protection.

subtypes.name: Busway with integrated metering
subtypes.description: Plug, standalone and end-feed meters enabling branch circuit monitoring.
